'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mass shootings in the United States]]
**[[2025 North Codorus Township shooting]]
***Three police officers are killed and two are critically injured in a [[mass shooting]] when a gunman opens fire during a [[search warrant]] at a farm in [[North Codorus Township, Pennsylvania|North Codorus Township]], [[Pennsylvania]], [[United States]]. The perpetrator is also killed. [https://www.nbcphiladelphia.com/news/local/live-updates-multiple-officers-shot-in-york-county-pennsylvania/4271002/ (WCAU-TV)]

**[[Indonesia]]'s [[Constitutional Court of Indonesia|Constitutional Court]] rules that [[People's Consultative Assembly|parliament]] followed proper procedure in passing amendments to the [[Indonesian National Armed Forces Law|military law]], rejecting a petition that sought to annul the amendments.
